summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3 new features: Avatar Upload, My Rank endpoint, and League System. All backend APIs pass (22/22 tests, 100%). All frontend UI components are present and functional.

avatar_upload_tests: POST /api/users/avatar - accepts image upload and returns avatar URL
POST /api/users/avatar - uploaded avatar reflects in user profile
my_rank_tests: GET /api/users/my-rank - returns global rank with rank and total
GET /api/users/my-rank - returns club rank when favorite_club is set
GET /api/users/my-rank - returns country rank when country is set
league_system_tests: POST /api/leagues - creates public league with invite code
POST /api/leagues - creates private league with invite code
GET /api/leagues - lists leagues with membership status
GET /api/leagues?league_type=public - filters to public leagues only
POST /api/leagues/join-code/{code} - joins private league by invite code
POST /api/leagues/{id}/join - returns 400 when already a member
POST /api/leagues/{id}/leave - returns 404 when not a member
GET /api/leagues/{id} - returns league details with leaderboard
integration_tests: League rank appears in my-rank after joining
frontend_pages: Dashboard - 'YOUR RANK' section with Global, Club, Country rank cards
Dashboard - League ranks displayed below rank cards
Matchmaking - League creation form with name input, Public/Private toggle
Matchmaking - Private League Code input with JOIN button
Matchmaking - League list with member counts and JOIN/LEAVE buttons
Profile - Change avatar button with camera icon
Profile - Your Rank section with Global, Club, Country ranks
Onboarding - Avatar upload button alongside preset avatars (code verified)

seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed leagues created during testing. Avatar files stored in /app/backend/uploads/

avatar_upload.backend: POST /api/users/avatar accepts multipart form-data, validates image type, stores in /app/backend/uploads/, updates user profile
avatar_upload.frontend_onboarding: Avatar upload button with Camera icon alongside 8 preset avatars (data-testid='avatar-upload-btn')
avatar_upload.frontend_profile: Change avatar button with camera icon (data-testid='change-avatar-btn')

my_rank.backend: GET /api/users/my-rank returns global, club (if set), country (if set), and leagues rankings
my_rank.frontend_dashboard: 'YOUR RANK' section with 3 rank cards (Global, Club, Country) plus league ranks
my_rank.frontend_profile: 'Your Rank' section displaying same ranking information

league_system.backend_crud: Full CRUD - create public/private leagues, list with membership status, join/leave, join by invite code, get details with leaderboard
league_system.frontend_matchmaking: LEAGUES section with create form (name + public/private toggle), private league code input, league list with JOIN/LEAVE buttons

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features fully implemented and tested. Backend uses PostgreSQL (not MongoDB). Auth is cookie-based with session_token. Avatar files stored in /app/backend/uploads/ served via /api/uploads/. League model uses league_type field (public/private). Test user testuser@quizball.com is in multiple leagues. Many TEST_ prefixed leagues exist from testing.
